partner.intro.title: A thoughtful collaboration
partner.intro.body: Just Women welcomes thoughtful collaboration with media organizations, human rights groups, educators, journalists, researchers, and technical professionals who share our commitment to women's voices, ethical storytelling, and learning opportunities.

partner.o1.title: Media Partnerships
partner.o1.copy: Editorial collaboration, interviews, reporting, and story development.
partner.o2.title: Professional Experts
partner.o2.copy: Journalism, research, translation, editing, and technical expertise.
partner.o3.title: Educational Partners
partner.o3.copy: Potential workshops, mentorship, and learning initiatives.
partner.o4.title: Responsible Support
partner.o4.copy: Transparent, verified, and appropriate forms of support.
partner.commit.title: How we work together
partner.commit.body: We emphasize editorial independence, transparency, informed consent, safety, and the responsible use of resources in every collaboration.
partner.updates.title: A space for verified activities
partner.updates.body: We will share verified activities, public reports, and genuine achievements here as they become available. Formal partnerships, grants, and impact reports are not yet listed. If you would like to explore a collaboration, we welcome a conversation.
